name: GAX
fix_description: Function 0x6c99d7c8 transfers tokens to msg.sender with user-supplied amount (arg1) without validating against any deposit/stake records. Any caller can pass an arbitrary amount and receive that many tokens. Fix: validate arg1 <= userStake[msg.sender] and deduct from balance.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a one-step exploit consisting of a single low-level call with crafted calldata to drain BUSD from the vulnerable contract. It requires minimal protocol understanding, no flash loans or multi-contract interactions, and the exploit code is extremely short and straightforward.
